claims.statement: The repository is the SE373 Analytics Agent course project, a natural-language analytics agent over a fictional Vietnamese business database, currently in initial setup with wiki/PRD tooling but no landed agent or loader code.
Local setup requires Node.js >=24, pnpm >=10 with pnpm@11.25.0 activated via Corepack, plus an uncommitted OpenCode Go API key.
The canonical local run is corepack enable, pin pnpm@11.25.0, pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, copy .env.example to .env and fill in OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY, then pnpm wiki:update:print.

Repository entrypoints are the pnpm wiki:* scripts: wiki:init for first generation, wiki:update / wiki:update:print for updates, wiki:dry-run for validation, and wiki:visualize for static-site export.

Every wiki script preloads scripts/openwiki-fetch-patch.mjs, which injects a stable opaque x-opencode-session header (ses_ plus 32 hex chars) on opencode.ai requests to satisfy the mandatory OpenCode Go routing/cache requirement.

Inference must use the Responses API (OPENWIKI_OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_USE_RESPONSES_API=true) because muse-spark-1.3-contributor is Responses-only; routing to /chat/completions fails with ModelProtocolUnsupported surfaced as HTTP 401.

Scheduled wiki CI runs daily at 08:00 UTC plus on demand on Node 24, installs with pnpm/action-setup and actions/setup-node, runs the same wiki update command, and opens a docs-only auto-merge PR limited to openwiki, AGENTS.md, and CLAUDE.md.

The normative agent design is the LangGraph reference workflow (understand, retrieve semantic layer, plan, generate/validate/explain/execute/fix SQL, mask PII, chart, reviewer) backed by a common harness contract covering read-only DB tools, semantic search, chart rendering, alerting, skills, and audit traces.

The target database must be a fictional Vietnamese business database with at least 8 related tables, one table of at least one million rows, fake PII columns, and hidden seeded drift/anomaly/injection scenarios loaded by a one-command script.

Every implementation task is constrained by mandatory project rules (self-built agent with no hosted text-to-SQL/BI products, read-only connection-layer enforcement, synthetic-only PII, Python/TypeScript with a LangGraph-style workflow) and the submitted use-case set must cover all eight knowledge areas K1-K8.
Local setup requires Node.js >=24 and pnpm >=10 with repo-pinned pnpm@11.25.0 activated via Corepack, followed by frozen-lockfile install and non-interactive wiki update.
Local runs copy .env.example to .env to supply OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY, while .env is never committed and CI instead maps the OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY secret to that variable.

Every pnpm wiki:* script preloads scripts/openwiki-fetch-patch.mjs, which injects a stable opaque x-opencode-session header (ses_ plus 32 hex chars) for opencode.ai requests, deterministic per GitHub run and random per local process without overwriting an existing value.

The inference provider must keep OPENWIKI_OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_USE_RESPONSES_API=true because the pinned muse-spark-1.3-contributor model is Responses-only; setting false routes to /chat/completions and fails as ModelProtocolUnsupported.

Scheduled wiki CI runs daily at 08:00 UTC plus on-demand on Node 24, installs with pnpm/action-setup and actions/setup-node, runs OpenWiki update, and opens a docs-only auto-merge PR limited to openwiki, AGENTS.md, and CLAUDE.md.

The wiki read boundary in .openwikiignore excludes secrets, generated state, dependencies, and data dumps, so docs cite .env.example and loader or schema files and never reproduce .env contents or data-dump rows.

Agent documentation is organized by system rather than source directory: workflow-architecture owns the reference understand-retrieve-plan-generate-validate-cost-gate-execute-mask-chart-review loop, semantic-layer owns the knowledge corpus and hybrid retrieval, and safety-and-access-control owns read-only, validation, cost-gate, RBAC, masking, and injection defenses.

The target business database requires at least 8 related tables with a >=1M-row table and fake-PII columns, plus hidden seeded fixtures of at least 3 drift scenarios, 5 anomalies, and 3 injections, loadable by one command such as python -m data.load.

Submitted use-case designs route to use-cases/text-to-sql for UC-01 bounded self-repair, use-cases/root-cause-and-anomaly for UC-05 branching analysis and UC-10 scheduled anomaly alerts, and integrations/mcp-server for the UC-09 database MCP server and operator surfaces.

Verification routes to evals/eval-and-safety-harness: evals run by one command with execution-accuracy grading, per-UC metrics, regression comparison, hidden gold results, and at least 5 mandatory attack and safety cases.

Hard invariants apply to every agent task: the team self-builds the SQL path without hosted text-to-SQL or BI products, connects with a read-only account enforced at the connection layer, uses only synthetic or public data with fake PII, and implements in Python or TypeScript with a LangGraph-style workflow.

Current pnpm scripts are not wiki-only: package.json defines wiki:init, wiki:update, wiki:update:print, wiki:dry-run, wiki:visualize plus typecheck (tsc -b), lint (eslint .), test (vitest run), and docs:interface (tsx scripts/generate-interface.mjs).

pnpm docs:interface regenerates docs/mcp_interface.md from the frozen Zod schemas in packages/contracts, covering list_tables, describe_table, explain_query, run_query, sample_rows and the shared error-code table; the generated file must not be hand-edited.

The OpenCode Go provider must stay on the Responses API (OPENWIKI_OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_USE_RESPONSES_API=true) because the pinned muse-spark-1.3-contributor model is Responses-only; false routes to /chat/completions and fails as ModelProtocolUnsupported.

Scheduled wiki CI runs daily at 08:00 UTC plus on demand on Node 24 with pnpm frozen-lockfile install, executes OpenWiki with code --update --print, and opens a docs-only auto-merge PR limited to openwiki, AGENTS.md, and CLAUDE.md.

Wiki runs must not read or reproduce secrets (.env), generated wiki state, dependencies/build output, or ignored data dumps (data/*.csv|*.parquet|*.db|*.sqlite|*.duckdb); documentation covers the loader script and schema files instead.

The monorepo foundation (harness architecture, package boundaries, shared contracts, lint boundaries) is built, while per-use-case agent behavior remains planned in docs/UC-plan and the openwiki domain pages.
